answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a basalt-hard proof of sustained work: before earning reputation, the agent must run useful tasks for a probationary window while its activity is published to a public beacon ledger. Peers then grow a trellis of mutual attestations, only vouching for agents whose recorded work they can verify, so a single attacker must fund the full cost of real, checkable labor for every fake identity instead of cloning accounts for free.
